prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1138; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured driver reporting a low-speed head-on collision at an intersection. Insured states the other vehicle crossed the centerline while making a turn. Insured reports neck and lower back discomfort at scene but declined EMS transport. Photos requested and vehicle inspection scheduled.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from the claimant, who is not represented by counsel. Claimant describes a jolt to the front end at low speed, with no airbag deployment. Reports lower back strain beginning within hours of the collision and has been seen at an urgent care clinic. Claimant was advised of the right to seek legal advice and stated they will handle the matter directly for now.

Entry 3: Vehicle damage appraisal completed on both vehicles. Bumper cover, grille, and hood latch damage noted on the insured vehicle. Claimant vehicle shows rear-end contact consistent with a secondary impact. Estimates received and under review. Scene photos show minimal intrusion into passenger compartments.

Entry 4: Medical documentation received from the claimant's urgent care visit. Diagnosis listed as lumbar strain with muscle spasm, prescribed rest, over-the-counter anti-inflammatories, and a follow-up in two weeks. Requested authorization for records from the treating provider. Claimant has not yet returned the signed release form.

Entry 5: Liability investigation in progress. Police report reviewed and indicates the other driver was cited for an improper lane change. Statements from both drivers are consistent on the point of impact. Reserve reviewed and adjusted pending medical follow-up. Claimant reminded that a status update will be provided after the next treatment review.
